tools.name: get_daily_digest
tools.description: Return the top ~12 trending topics for a vertical as a daily briefing. Use this when the user asks "what is trending today", "what is the AI news today", or wants a quick roundup. tools.name: list_trends
tools.description: Search and list trending topics for a vertical with optional filters. Use this to answer "what is happening with <keyword>", to filter by platform, or to pull a ranked list. keywords/platforms narrow the results; sort="hot" (default) ranks by heat, sort="time" by recency; limit is 1-50 (default 20);

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Fetch one trending topic by its topicId (as returned by get_daily_digest / list_trends). Use this to drill into a specific story. Returns "topic not found" if the id is unknown or the topic no longer clears the public quality gate. Topic page: https://buzzradr.com/hot/{topicId}.

tools.name: get_source_health
tools.description: Report the ingestion sources behind a vertical and their health: status, last fetch time, accepted/filtered item counts, and any public message. Use this to check data freshness or which platforms feed the radar.
